name: experts_used
title: Fewer routed experts per token than the model file says (run-time K)

needs.model_file: the served GGUF (IQ4_XS) plus a larger reference GGUF (Q8_0) for the quality check

parity_check: build/experts_used_parity (ninja experts_used_parity): router, grouping and combine kernels for K = 1..8 against a host reference, no model; with the switch unset the engine output must be unchanged from main (same greedy tokens)
notes: Output changes by design: judge each K by the KLD table (mean KLD, 99% KLD, same-token %, PPL ratio) against the K = 8 row, then by tok/s, MTP draft acceptance, and package temperature. The env var is the engine switch, --experts-used the launcher's mapping of it; either gives the same run. A value above the file's count stops the engine with a message.
